cohort: A total of 70 parturients undergoing cesarean section in the Telangana population, with 35 receiving ephedrine and 35 receiving normal saline during spinal anaesthesia.
finding: I.V. infusion of Ephedrine was more effective than crystalloid preloading in preventing hypotension in parturients undergoing cesarean section without causing hemodynamic complications.
mod_finding: The primary finding confirms the efficacy of I.V. ephedrine in preventing hypotension specifically in parturients undergoing cesarean section.
